Build a per-feature annotation lookup table

build_annot_lookup.Rd

Indexes an annotate_res data frame by feature_name. Only rows with annotation_phase == "Phase1" are used (Phase2 _exp rows are dropped here; call this on the full table and it will filter internally). adduct_match is taken directly from grp_anno_match with no group-level fallback: in this data model, grp_anno_match is already populated whenever a feature genuinely has a Tier1a/Tier1b precursor or isotope match, so a feature with an empty grp_anno_match should get no label — not one inherited from the compound's overall ion type. (A prior version promoted group_ion_type into adduct_match for any row lacking its own annotation; that caused every unannotated fragment in a group to share the same "M+H+" label text as the true precursor feature, so the plot's per-label intensity-based dedup would silently keep whichever row was tallest — not necessarily the real precursor — and point the leader line at the wrong peak.) A nl_label field is also stored: it is non-empty only when grp_anno_match itself already encodes a neutral loss (e.g. "[M+H-H2O]+ 274.131742" -> "[M+H-H2O]+"). NL_match is not used for plot labels.

Usage

build_annot_lookup(annotate_res, group_ion_type = "")

Arguments

annotate_res

Data frame of per-feature annotation rows (e.g. StM14_annotate_res_ms1). Expected columns include feature_name, grp_anno_match, grp_anno_ppm, grp_anno_mda, grp_anno_confidence, iso_annotation, annotation_phase.

group_ion_type

Unused (kept for call-site compatibility).

Value

Named list keyed by feature_name
